name: spellkave_attach_map_layer
label: Attach Map Layer
description: Author a [[map_layers]] backdrop pointer for a place_graph (Phandelver parity). Does NOT vendor the image — asset_path resolves at map_graph time via CCC3_MAPS_ROOT or FVTT_DATA_ROOT. Optionally stamps provenance metadata on the graph. When the file is present, image_width/height are filled from PNG IHDR if unset.

asset_path.description: Relative path under asset root, e.g. "maps/306 Fortified Hamlet.jpg" for ccc3-maps.

asset_module.description: Asset root module id (default "ccc3-maps"). Also resolves FVTT_DATA_ROOT/<module>.

map_id.description: Catalog map id for provenance payload.

promptSnippet: Attach an out-of-repo map image layer to a place_graph
promptGuidelines: Use after author_place. asset_module ccc3-maps + asset_path maps/<file>.
Images never go in git; map_graph overlays them when CCC3_MAPS_ROOT resolves.
just map-font-check is unrelated — this is bitmap backdrops, not terminal fonts.
